messages:
ana: Heads up — since ~02:44 UTC a set of eu-central1 scratch nodes spiked iowait and NVMe write amplification. GPUs trying to attach are hitting 3-7m delays.
vikram: Saw that. Alert: `localnvme.write_amp > 5` on eu-central1-c for 22m. Attach throughput down ~28%.
chong: Any kernel oops or dmesg lines?
ana: Found repeating pattern: `overlayfs: rename_overflow` and `blk_update_request: I/O error` interleaved on a few hosts. Not typical SMART wear flags.
vikram: That overlayfs rename loop smells like snapshot compaction + model cache warmup churn. We pushed nightly model-cache prefetch job at 02:30 UTC across the cohort.
chong: If compact + warmup both do many tiny renames/writes, NVMe small-block pressure skyrockets. Can we pause the prefetch job for eu-central cohort?
ana: I'll mute the prefetch cron for the eu-central affinity group now.
infra-bot: prefetch job eu-central-model-cache-push paused by ana at 02:55 UTC.
vikram: Meanwhile, recommend marking affected hosts PreferNoSchedule for GPU so scheduler prefers other racks but still allows emergency placement. Quick taint: `kubectl taint nodes node-zz scratch-hot=1:PreferNoSchedule`
chong: Also drop background compaction workers from 8 -> 2 on that cohort, rolling config in rollout-service. I'll make the change.
ana: We should proactively clear stale overlay temporary files that block rename merges — running a safe cleanup script on hosts with low CPU.
vikram: Running cleanup on node-079, node-081 sequentially. Using:
```
ssh node-079 'find /scratch/overlay -maxdepth 2 -type f -name "tmp.*" -mtime +1 -print -exec rm -f {} \;'
```
chong: After pausing prefetch and dropping compaction parallelism, IO spikes reduced. Attach queue shrank by ~60% in the last 7m.
infra-bot: node-081 reported 30% fewer `blk_update_request` lines after cleanup.
vikram: For medium-term, propose: 1) model-cache warmup staggered across zones (wave schedule), 2) add small-write coalescer in local scratch layer (50-200ms window), 3) compaction backoff when overlay rename latency > 200ms. I'll draft a postmortem and RFC.
chong: Also propose a hot-reserve of two NVMe-free hosts per zone for GPU attaches during heavier maintenance windows. Prevents cascading attach delays.
ana: Note on cost: hot-reserve increases standby capacity cost ~6% if kept reserved; but we can make it ephemeral and only spin up when io-signal crosses threshold.
vikram: Agreed. For now let's keep the prefetch paused for 60m and watch. Can someone update #incidents?
ana: Will post a short blurb. Tagging support if attach failures > 1%.
infra-bot: Monitoring rule `attach.latency` now in watch mode for eu-central1. Will escalate if >5% regression for 10m.
scale-bot: routing override applied: prefer eu-west1 for new GPU allocations for 30m to reduce customer latency impact.
chong: Observed one node with bad block count slightly rising (node-081). Scheduling SMART long self-test off-peak.
vikram: Thanks all. Keep thread updated if we see regressions or more host errors.
nana: Re-enabling prefetch only after attach latency stable for 20m. Will coordinate with compaction rollout. :thumbsup:
